question: GKHL is related to IMJN in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, KOLP is related to MQNR. To which of the following is NROS related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/914456ecd02a295fcb6a97049dfda1145c674dab9f03e8a7de5db8403c4b7657.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**GKHL: IMJN**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ef9d0b188e788a46acfedf1e2c6b8d27dbdd324a85edb2457e6590d9e8dad47.png] 

**KOLP: MQNR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/979d263c322f6b1ff6b9d2edfec336975641ee3e271a6354e125fb9a3966aa11.png] 

Similarly,

**NROS: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b8d776608dd03fa903d9fd3301433a61eebc50b29fcf427dc1ac509e0c91949.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"PTQU"**.
